name: llm-grounded
description: Deterministic grounding and voice contract for OpenClaw agents.

enabledAgents.description: Agent ids this contract applies to. Empty array means every agent.

evidenceDir.description: Directory for per-session grounding evidence records.

maxRevisions.description: Bounded extra model passes requested when grounding is missing.

stateTtlSeconds.description: How long per-turn grounding state is retained.

maxTrackedTurns.description: Upper bound on concurrently tracked turns.

factsEnabled.description: Register the guarded vault_fact_commit tool. Off unless explicitly enabled.

factsAgents.description: Agent ids allowed to use vault_fact_commit. Empty array means no agent.

vaultPath.description: Vault root passed to the Vault Tools writer. Never model-supplied.

factsCliPath.description: Absolute path to the Vault Tools fact transaction entry point.

pythonPath.description: Interpreter used to run the Vault Tools writer.

caseTimeoutMs.description: Budget for the isolated CASE audit completion.

factTimeoutMs.description: Budget for the Vault Tools fact transaction.

maxEvidenceItems.description: How many successful wiki retrievals are bound into the audit packet.

maxEvidenceChars.description: Per-excerpt character bound for bound vault evidence.

maxFactRevisions.description: Bounded extra model passes when an eligible turn skipped the fact tool.

maxVoiceRevisions.description: Bounded extra passes requested when a reply violates the voice rules. 0 disables the voice gate.

voiceMaxWords.description: Word count above which a reply is treated as long. Targets the tail, not the median.

behaviorEpoch.description: Label for the behaviour regime that produced a record. Bump on every deliberate behaviour change.

telemetryDir.description: Directory for per-turn telemetry (JSONL, one file per day). Empty disables logging.

telemetryRetentionDays.description: Days of turn telemetry retained. Day files older than this are pruned.

directSessionPrefixes.description: Explicit session-key prefixes treated as a direct owner conversation. Group and channel keys are refused structurally and cannot be allowed here.

personalTerms.description: Names, projects, hosts and schedule vocabulary belonging to the operator. Matched case-insensitively on word boundaries; questions containing one route to memory rather than the web, and the words are never mistaken for external proper nouns.

agentNames.description: Names this agent answers to. Being addressed by name is stripped before classification, so a capitalised agent name is not read as a reference to the outside world.

promptFiles.description: Absolute paths to the prompt surfaces hashed into each telemetry record. Contents are never copied into a record. Missing files hash as absent.

evidenceDir.label: Evidence directory
evidenceDir.help: Mission Control reads per-session grounding evidence from here.

factsEnabled.label: Enable vault fact transactions
factsEnabled.help: Registers vault_fact_commit. Requires llm.allowAgentIdOverride for the CASE audit.

vaultPath.label: Vault root
vaultPath.help: Passed to the Vault Tools writer.

maxVoiceRevisions.label: Voice revisions
maxVoiceRevisions.help: Set to 0 to disable the voice gate without reinstalling.

telemetryDir.label: Turn telemetry directory
telemetryDir.help: Per-turn records used to measure classifier false positives. Empty disables.

vault_fact_commit.label: Vault Fact Commit
vault_fact_commit.help: Guarded same-turn transaction that records or corrects one durable personal fact. Owner-authenticated direct turns only.
